response.justification: Bogdan has extensive fullstack experience with TypeScript, React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL-like SQL databases, plus strong architectural and DevOps exposure, but his seniority level far exceeds the junior/mid role, he lacks clear recent experience with Nest.js or renewable energy tech, and his German language skill is only basic despite high on-site requirements.
strengths: Deep TypeScript and fullstack experience across React, Node.js, and REST APIs
Proven track record in scalable systems, DevOps, and open-source architecture
Strong learning ability and teaching background in software practices
concerns: Overqualified for junior/mid role; risk of mismatched expectations or turnover
No explicit experience with Nest.js or renewable energy/construction tech domain
Basic German proficiency conflicts with high on-site presence requirement
